name: label
useFor: Use Label to name a control: above an Input, or wrapping (or htmlFor-paired with) a Checkbox, RadioGroupItem or Switch. Inside a Field use FieldLabel, which wires itself to the control. Mark a required field with a span data-slot="label-required".
constraints: Caps or Kode Mono labels on fields
A placeholder in place of a label
An orange label on an invalid field
source: Extrapolated from the Hoplite website: its 14px medium control type (.button labels, .pr-period__option) and the principles' 14px medium labels above fields
title: Label
description: A field's label: 14px Satoshi medium in the ink, above its field or 8px beside a check, radio or switch; a required mark in orange; the slate when its control is disabled.
